what_this_is: Adjudication of prediction P3 of evidence/T06/R2_COLLAPSE_DIAGNOSIS.md §4 for the KL-anchored 50k checkpoint r2kl_seed0_50000f.pt, together with the P1/P2 facts its P4 rule depends on. Pure evaluation: the frozen evaluator is run, nothing is trained, no implementation file is modified.
declaration: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so this is a training-time privileged diagnostic; it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1). No capability claim may be made from it: every arm here is 0/20 clears.
revision_note: An earlier trial aggregation of this file (written 03:17Z, when exactly one episode existed) carried frames_mean = 1425.0 -- the single episode seed 1000, not a 20-episode mean -- and judged P3 fail on it. That was wrong and is superseded: the 20-seed diag mean is 1512.1 and it is inside the pre-registered band.

prediction_under_test.text: 20 dev episodes: diag_first_death frames mean inside 1473-1800 (1636.8 +/-10% of R0) AND s1n frames mean inside 2710-3313 (3011.5 +/-10% of R0)

p1.prediction: max_t KL_T1(A0||pi_t) <= 0.05 nat over the whole 50k run
p1.interpretation: 49 of 49 rollouts exceeded the bound; the best one was still 4.0x over it. This is a criterion that is unreachable by construction (a maximum over ~50k scored positions against 0.05 nat), not an implementation defect, and the fail-closed gate in the code must NOT be relaxed or downgraded: the run stays failed
p1.gate_disposition: keep fail-closed as is; the revision belongs in the criterion (replace the per-position worst case with a comparison-set policy KL and declare it a criterion revision, not a relaxation)

p4.decision_rule: the P4 paragraph of R2_COLLAPSE_DIAGNOSIS.md §4 conditions the 'drift is cleared' branch on diag < 1473
p4.reason: the premise diag < 1473 is false (1512.1, inside the pre-registered band), so neither the 'drift is cleared -> reward/ruler mismatch' branch nor a clean claim of P3 as a whole is authorized: the diag leg holds, the s1n leg is incomplete
p4.supported_reading: the drift was the culprit and the KL anchor works in deployment space: same-space argmax flip 0.0117 vs R2's 0.617 (-98%); the anchored arm beats the unanchored R2 by +622.75 frames per seed on average with 20/20 positive paired differences, and lands inside R0's +/-10% band
p4.not_supported_reading: that P3 as a whole holds (s1n leg not measured), that the anchor improves capability (still 0/20 clears), or that the 0.05 nat criterion can be met by this anchor
p4.one_line: 漂移是元凶且 KL 锚在部署空间有效（同空间 argmax 翻转 −98%、配对 +622.75 帧 vs R2 无锚、20/20 全正、diag 1512.1 落在预注册带内），但 P4 的第三段前提（diag < 1473）不成立，且 s1n 腿 10/20 未完成，故 P4 不被授权、整条 P3 判为 diag hold / s1n incomplete

cross_reference_kl_anchor_evidence.agreement: same numbers: diag 1512.1 (n=20), s1n 2626.0 (n=20), +622.75 diag paired difference vs R2 with 20/20 positive, frozen-slot flip 0.0117 vs 0.617, max |mean dlogit| 1.5156, P1 0.8793 vs 0.05
cross_reference_kl_anchor_evidence.difference: that document owns a 20/20 s1n sample and therefore adjudicates P3 as fail by conjunction (s1n 84 frames below the band); this task owns only 10/20 s1n and therefore reports P3 as 'diag hold / s1n incomplete' and does not adjudicate that leg
cross_reference_kl_anchor_evidence.combined_reading: diag leg holds; s1n leg reads below band in every sample taken (own 10: 2499.8; replication 20: 2626.0), so the conjunction P3 reads fail on the s1n leg -- the judgement itself belongs to RL_KL_ANCHOR.md, which owns the complete s1n sample
cross_reference_kl_anchor_evidence.note_on_this_file: an earlier 20:15Z version of this JSON had s1n n = 0 because this task's s1n batches were still running; the current version has n = 10

not_claimed: the s1n leg is not a 20-episode measurement; no hold/fail is claimed for it

the pre-registered diag band is +/-10% while this ruler's per-seed spread is ~17% of the mean (sd 150 frames, min 1117, max 1751), so a 20-episode mean carries an SE of ~34 frames: 'inside the band' is consistent with R0 but is not a precise equality
no confidence interval is attached to any mean and no interval comparison is made
R2 is engine-truth reward, not R1 strict pixel self-improvement
the KL anchor does not raise capability: every arm is 0/20 clears
no extrapolation to the 1M-frame tier or to 3 seeds
no factor decomposition of the frame differences
score.dat equality between the reference runs and this one is empirical, not proven
the 20-seed diag sample is assembled from two independent runs; 10 of the 20 are this task's own and 10 come from a concurrent run by another agent
P1's failure is not evidence that the implementation is wrong; it is evidence that the 0.05 nat worst-case criterion is unreachable
